note: Two dictionaries that keep a lens's CERTAINTY at or below its source's.
STRENGTHENERS raise a claim. A lens may use one only if the source does.
LOAD_BEARING_HEDGES are the words that mark a thing as not-yet-established. If the source
carries ANY of them, the lens must carry at least one too. This is the single most valuable
check in the pipeline: it is what stops 'a SIMULATION of a flagellar motor' from becoming
'a flagellar motor' — the exact truth-laundering the estate's contract forbids, and the exact
thing a well-meaning plain-language rewrite does by accident, because hedges read as clutter.
